jobs.title: Graduate Data Analyst
jobs.content: <p>Example Payments is hiring a Graduate Data Analyst to support our risk and growth teams.</p><ul><li>Query transaction data with SQL and BigQuery</li><li>Clean data and automate reports in Python</li><li>Build Looker Studio and Tableau dashboards</li><li>Run A/B testing analysis for product experiments</li></ul><p>Requirements: degree in Statistics, Economics or Computer Science; strong Excel and SQL skills; good communication and stakeholder engagement. Knowledge of ETL tools is a plus.</p>
